scripts.lint: bunx biome check src astro.config.mjs && bunx oxlint src --ignore-pattern 'src/layouts/*'
scripts.lint:fix: bunx biome check src astro.config.mjs --write && bunx oxlint src --ignore-pattern 'src/layouts/*' --fix --fix-suggestions
scripts.ship: bun run predeploy && git push origin main && node scripts/deploy-check.mjs
scripts.predeploy: bun run lint && bunx astro check && bun run build && bun test
